decisions.reason: Transactional email is a growing cloud service that the firm featured on its home page, which suggests it meets aspirations within the firm's core messaging portfolio, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search.
Managed capture has its own page and a documented customer reference, so its results look at or above aspiration and it fits the firm's established document and fax workflow business.
Email and fax conversion builds on the firm's core fax infrastructure, so carrying it costs little and the firm has no reason to drop it while it serves existing customers.
As a low-cost feature that strengthens the established fax service, it is likely to be kept, though it could be absorbed into the base offering instead of being marketed separately.

Sandbox threat protection is a core part of a growing email security portfolio, and the firm already searched and dropped the weaker virus-scanning offering, which leaves this one as the retained solution.
